**Finding: compliant (preferred position met) — no redline proposed.**

- **Only MFN in the document runs to us.** § 6 (p0047) states: *"TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party."* This is a Vendor-granted MFN plus a one-year price freeze in Mortgage Logic.com's favour — a benefit to our party, which the rule expressly directs us not to flag or disturb.
- **No Customer-side MFN anywhere.** § 5 (Compensation) imposes only ordinary payment obligations (schedule of charges, monthly invoices, 15-day payment); § 8 (Covenants and Warranties of Client) covers compliance with laws, notification, access limits, the Credit Data licence, content warranties and spamming — none require us to offer TrueLink terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers. Searches across the full document for "favor"/"favour", "most", "best", "lowest", "no less", "third part", "rates", "charge", "exclusiv" and "terms and conditions" surfaced no responsive Client obligation, and Exhibits A and B contain only charges payable by us.
- **Result:** the preferred element ("Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor") is already met, so the fallback checklist is not engaged and no redline is warranted. We should resist any Vendor attempt to delete or dilute the p0047 rate-comparison undertaking in negotiation, since it is the MFN protection working for us.
